discussion:
# Principle

Lessons learnt from cyber security incidents are captured, and areas for improvement are identified, prioritised and actioned in a timely manner.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- Post-incident reviews are not conducted.

Partially effective:
- Post-incident reviews are conducted for some incidents but not all that meet the severity threshold defined by the organisation.
- Reviews are conducted but findings are not documented or actioned.

Fully effective:
- Post-incident reviews are conducted for all incidents meeting the severity threshold defined by the organisation.
- Findings identify the specific gaps that enabled each stage of the incident.
- Remediation actions arising from findings are implemented and tracked to closure.
title: Perform post-cyber security incident reviews to identify the security gaps that enabled each stage of the cyber security incident.
